purpose: Place two Principle invariance declarations on distinct named sides without deciding equivalence.

required.statement: Preserve definition and introduction sides, distinct identities, exact source locations, opaque payloads, nine unresolved identifiers, unresolved comparison statuses, and TLC-EA-HUIT-009-001.
Return an immutable deterministic two-sided InvarianceDeclarationComparison.

forbidden.statement: Do not infer equivalence, deduplicate, merge, interpret, resolve boundary or identity, or use lexical similarity as evidence.
Do not alias identities, lose source locations, mutate inputs, or publish partial success.

deferred.statement: Equivalence, feature boundary, identity, types, signatures, units, order, aggregation, numerics, and oracle semantics remain unresolved.
Concrete runtime representation and resource choices remain implementation-defined.

operations.purpose: Validate and preserve two named comparison sides with unresolved statuses.

inputs.name: claims
inputs.semantic_role: exact definition and introduction side pair

constraints.statement: Both source identities and source locations are distinct and transport order is non-semantic.
Both named sides, source locations, identities, types, payloads, and unresolved statuses are preserved.

preconditions.statement: Both claims, distinct identities, both exact source locations, traces, reservations, and assumption are present.
No equivalence, deduplication, merge, interpretation, or boundary-resolution request is present.

postconditions.statement: Definition and introduction sides remain separate and unchanged.
Equivalence, feature boundary, identity, and all nine reservations remain unresolved.

invariants.statement: Two-sided identity, source locations, types, payload bytes, traces, and limited status remain unchanged.
Identical text does not imply equivalence and no external state is modified.

steps: validate sides identities locations and traces

partial_order.before: validate sides identities locations and traces

prescription_basis: Observable side identity, source preservation, and unresolved statuses constrain publication; no semantic comparison algorithm is prescribed.

error_contract.condition: Schema-compatible public alias for authoritative source error FAIL-HUIT-009-MISSING-TRACE: a required side, identity, trace, reservation, or assumption is missing.
Schema-compatible public alias for authoritative source error FAIL-HUIT-009-OPERATION: equivalence, deduplication, aliasing, boundary resolution, or source-location loss is requested or detected.
Schema-compatible public alias for authoritative source error FAIL-HUIT-009-SCIENTIFIC-INVENTION: claim interpretation or unstated comparison semantics are supplied.

implementation_modes.statement: Expose both preserved sides with unresolved statuses.
Do not decide equivalence, merge, or deduplicate claims.
Internal architecture is free when observable obligations are satisfied.

global_invariants.statement: Side identity, source locations, opacity, unresolved comparison status, immutability, and provenance cannot be weakened.
Textual similarity never becomes a scientific equivalence result.

notes: Conformance is structural and does not authorize equivalence or prescribe a language, serialization, or total internal algorithm.
